name: iac-azure-agent
description: Plain-English Azure infrastructure in Bicep, with an approval-gated workflow. Milestone 2 of 6: first-run GitHub repository setup with read-only inspection, adaptive requirements discovery, architecture proposals for approval, per-project config, a persistent workflow state machine with hash-bound approvals, a secret guard and a shell guard against direct Azure changes. Bicep generation, publishing to GitHub and Azure deployment are not built yet.
